Component fixture: project and app configuration files from the published
@nativescript/ios 8.9.0 runtime template (Apache-2.0, NativeScript contributors).
This is the runtime's unprepared template, never an upstream CLI generated tree.
Runtime binaries, scripts and metadata executables are deliberately absent.
One trailing blank line in InfoPlist.strings is normalized. Tests using this fixture qualify graph preparation only, never native builds.
